name: comp-508
title: Two Month Range Calendar
blurb: Two-month calendar view for selecting date ranges at a glance.
description: Displays two consecutive months side-by-side in range mode. Uses paged navigation (forward/back arrows) to move through months. Separator line divides the two calendars.
use_when: Users need to span a range across two months and appreciate seeing both months simultaneously.
avoid_when: Very small screens where two months don't fit without horizontal scroll.
a11y: Calendar navigation is keyboard-accessible. aria-live announces date selections.
